ch0356_80_zeiyu/0101_0701_01_10:
[Name:PlayerNickname ]! It sounds like
there’s a festival. Are you going or what?
ch0356_80_zeiyu/0101_0701_02_10: C’MON! I’m going with, so let’s go already!
ch0356_80_zeiyu/7101_0701_01_10: Pasio is always hyped up over some festival.
ch0356_80_zeiyu/7101_0701_02_10:
But even more so, they constantly hold
festivals particularly to celebrate stuff.
Don’t you think?
ch0356_80_zeiyu/7101_0701_03_10:
Everyone gets into it—from the organizers
to the folks who join the fun.
ch0356_80_zeiyu/7102_0701_01_10:
Whenever I wear a jinbei like this, it reminds
me of my grandpa and grandma.
ch0356_80_zeiyu/7102_0701_02_10:
...I am NOT homesick, just so you know.
Got it?
ch0356_80_zeiyu/7102_0701_03_10: It’d just be nice to see them both. That’s all!
ch0356_80_zeiyu/7103_0701_01_10:
Some people on Pasio think jinbei are
old fashioned...
ch0356_80_zeiyu/7103_0701_02_10: but others find them new and interesting.
ch0356_80_zeiyu/7103_0701_03_10:
It seems people’s fashion tastes truly can
differ depending on where they’re raised.
ch0356_80_zeiyu/7103_0701_04_10:
Either way, I’m sure they all think it looks
charming, since I’M the one wearing it!
ch0356_80_zeiyu/7104_0701_01_10:
Mightyena always keep a watchful eye
for prey.
ch0356_80_zeiyu/7104_0701_02_10:
So if any guys captivated by me get
suspiciously close...
ch0356_80_zeiyu/7104_0701_03_10: my Mightyena will chase them off in a flash!
ch0356_80_zeiyu/7105_0701_01_10:
Time at a festival together can easily
become a happy memory.
ch0356_80_zeiyu/7105_0701_02_10:
Maybe our time at festivals is like that, huh,
[Name:PlayerNickname ]?
ch0356_80_zeiyu/7105_0701_03_10:
Hehehe. Consider it an honor to be part of
my memories!
ch0356_80_zeiyu/1701_0702_01_10: Don’t be afraid to use it all!
ch0356_80_zeiyu/2501_0701_01_10:
You OK? Not too mesmerized by me in my
jinbei, are you?
ch0356_80_zeiyu/2501_0701_02_10:
I only wear it during festivals, so it’s not
something you see often.
ch0356_80_zeiyu/2501_0701_03_10: Be grateful you get to see me like this!
ch0356_80_zeiyu/2501_0702_01_10:
You get to go to a festival with me in my
jinbei...
ch0356_80_zeiyu/2501_0702_02_10:
You’re sure to remember this for the rest of
your life!
ch0356_80_zeiyu/2511_0701_01_10:
After my encounter with Ogerpon in
Kitakami, I became interested in history.
ch0356_80_zeiyu/2511_0701_02_10:
It makes me wonder whether other Pokémon
are also becoming the subject of rumors.
ch0356_80_zeiyu/2511_0702_01_10:
If there are other misunderstood Pokémon out
there...
ch0356_80_zeiyu/2511_0702_02_10: I’ll protect them with everything I’ve got!
ch0356_80_zeiyu/2511_0702_03_10:
I feel sorry for anyone who’s treated like
a villain for no reason! Isn’t it infuriating?!
ch0356_80_zeiyu/3001_0701_01_10:
Whenever there’s an event, waking up in the
morning is easy!
ch0356_80_zeiyu/3003_0701_01_10:
It’s getting hot out. Be sure to wear
something light!
ch0356_80_zeiyu/3005_0701_01_10:
The festival’s only just begun! Wouldn’t a
fireworks finale be the best?
